exposure: gestational age (24+0-25+6 weeks, 26+0-27+6 weeks, 28+0-29+6 weeks, 30+0-31+6 weeks)
cohort: 15,814 infants born at 24+0-31+6 weeks gestational age from January 1, 2019, to December 31, 2020, and admitted within seven days after birth to the neonatal intensive care units in the Chinese Neonatal Network.
finding: Around 1% of VPIs in China developed SIP, which was associated with an increased risk of mortality and morbidities.
